title: Efficient Fine-Scale Simulation of Nonlinear Hyperelastic Lattice Structures
summary: With the growing maturity of additive manufacturing, the fabrication of architected or lattice-based metamaterials has become a reality for industrial applications. These materials combine lightweight design with tailored mechanical properties, most of which exhibit pronounced nonlinear, especially large-deformation, behaviors.
